info.description:
ServicePro is a field service management platform for service businesses.
This API provides endpoints for managing customers, jobs, quotes, invoices, and more.

Returns {"status"} publicly; the detailed report (dependency checks, version, git SHA) only in development, from loopback, or with X-Internal-Jobs-Token / Bearer INTERNAL_JOBS_SECRET
Returns 200 if the server is running (does not check dependencies). Kubernetes uses this to determine if the pod should be restarted.

Returns 200 if all critical dependencies are healthy (use as the Cloud Run startup probe). The "schema" check reports migration state (ok/ahead/behind/dirty); behind or dirty returns 503. Redis reports "not_configured" or "in_memory_fallback" without failing. Includes version and git_sha.

post.description: Internal job endpoint (auth: X-Internal-Jobs-Token header = INTERNAL_JOBS_SECRET; 404 when the secret is unset). Creates a scheduled job for every visit of every active service agreement over the next 14 days (each tenant's local dates). Idempotent: each (agreement, date) is claimed once. Mounted at the server root (/internal/jobs/agreement-visits), outside /api.

Internal job endpoint (auth: X-Internal-Jobs-Token header = INTERNAL_JOBS_SECRET; 404 when the secret is unset). Runs queued customer CSV imports for every tenant: each job is claimed atomically (pending → processing, FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED) before it runs, so overlapping runs never import a job twice; each job imports into its own tenant only. Jobs stuck in processing for 15 minutes are marked failed. Runs up to 20 jobs or 4 minutes per call. Mounted at the server root (/internal/jobs/imports), outside /api.

Internal job endpoint (auth: X-Internal-Jobs-Token header = INTERNAL_JOBS_SECRET; 404 when the secret is unset). Moves sent/viewed invoices due before today (UTC) to overdue, for every tenant. Idempotent (one conditional UPDATE). Mounted at the server root (/internal/jobs/invoice-overdue), outside /api.

Internal job endpoint (auth: X-Internal-Jobs-Token header = INTERNAL_JOBS_SECRET; 404 when the secret is unset). Sends due automatic payment reminders for every active tenant with reminders enabled. Idempotent: each (invoice, reminder number) is sent at most once, so re-running or overlapping runs send nothing twice. Mounted at the server root (/internal/jobs/payment-reminders), outside /api.

Internal job endpoint (auth: X-Internal-Jobs-Token header = INTERNAL_JOBS_SECRET; 404 when the secret is unset). Moves sent/viewed quotes past valid_until to expired, for every tenant. Idempotent (one conditional UPDATE). Mounted at the server root (/internal/jobs/quote-expiry), outside /api.

Currency is the ISO 4217 code the invoice is billed in, fixed at create
time from the tenant's currency setting (or the source quote's).

payment_pending_at.description:
PaymentPendingAt is set while a bank (ACH) payment the customer made
on the pay page settles (T170): reminders skip the invoice and no
second payment can start. Cleared when that payment succeeds or fails;
the status itself never changes for it.

CreatedBy is the staff member who recorded the payment; nil for
payments recorded by a Stripe webhook.

stripe_checkout_session_id.description:
Stripe references for online payments (nil for manually recorded
payments). A checkout session is applied at most once (unique index,
migration 000007).

created_by.description: CreatedBy is the staff member who recorded it; nil for webhooks.

stripe_payment_intent_id.description:
Stripe references (nil for manual refunds). The payment intent ties a
refund to the Checkout payment it reverses.

agreement_id.description: set on visits generated by a service agreement (T167)

billable.description: defaults to true when omitted on create; no gorm default:true (it stored false as true)

is_internal.description: Internal notes not visible to customer

AgreementID is set on visits a service agreement generated (T167);

allowed_transitions.description:
AllowedTransitions are the statuses POST /jobs/{id}/transition accepts

actions read this instead of keeping their own copy (T267).

completed_jobs.description: CompletedJobs counts completed, invoiced and paid.

pending_jobs.description: PendingJobs are new jobs not yet scheduled.

connected.description: Connected is true once a Stripe account exists for the tenant.
